scope: Art generation for review; 4 street views + 6 facilities, plus the existing lecture courtyard; no gameplay or runtime routing changes in this batch.

Authoritative lecture-court material finish, neutral daylight and brushwork

shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, game environment background.
Create ONE finished opaque 16:9 landscape image, approximately 1672x941, for a local interior/location scene inside Baishi immortal city. This is a standalone background asset, not a collage or contact sheet.
Use BOTH references as exact continuity references. Image 1 is Baishi's approved city overview: keep its distinct prosperous urban grey-brick and exposed dark-timber architecture, closed projecting upper-storey windows, merchant galleries, blue-grey roof planes, stepped firebreak gables and stone foundations. Image 2 is its already installed lecture courtyard: match the clean broad matte paint, cool desaturated grey-blue/ivory-grey/olive/low-chroma brown palette, material scale and calm natural daylight. Do not copy the lecture-courtyard composition for this scene. Do not replace Baishi architecture with Yuxu's cream-walled ceremonial sect palaces. The whole set must feel like the same city and the same daylight.
Painting: restrained matte gouache/watercolor pigment planes, soft hand-painted shapes with legible edges, subdued grey-blue structural shadows, broad foliage clusters, simplified believable architectural detail. No yellow/sepia wash, orange indoor filter, warm candlelit grading, saturated colors, black cartoon outlines, glossy 3D, photorealism, micro-etched tiles or dense white/gold stipple on trees and masonry.
Local scene scope: close enough to recognize the actual facility, large enough for gameplay background. Do not draw another whole-city overview or miniature walled settlement. Streets, doors, steps, galleries and stairs physically connect, supported beams and landings, consistent perspective; no impossible bridge joins. All four edges fully painted and clear, no blur, vignette, white faded borders or fog masking.
Leave natural low-clutter approach/floor space in the lower central part, with the important facility inside the middle 25%-78% of the image. Peripheral roofs, shelves or colonnades may crop beyond the frame to imply more space. Do not draw blank interface panels.
Strictly no people, human silhouettes, human statues, animals, player pawns, HUD, labels, paper tags, UI, readable writing, Chinese characters, calligraphy, signage, numbers, lettering, emblems or watermark. Books and notices have entirely blank/unlettered surfaces. Props are environmental set dressing, not new gameplay systems.

entries.title: 南街
entries.description: 客栈前的弯曲主街与连续临街楼廊。
entries.scene: Scene: SOUTH STREET, the southern commercial approach visible in reference 1. A slightly elevated oblique view from roughly one upper-storey height, looking down a broad stone-paved street that bends from lower center into the middle distance. The recognizable large inn/teahouse with grey-brick ground floor, tall enclosed timber upper floors, projecting occupied galleries and a raised central gable stands on the LEFT middle. Other varied merchant facades and deep empty awnings line the RIGHT, with a smaller side lane physically branching between two buildings. A few empty benches and modest stacked goods under an awning suggest a used city street. The street continues beyond the image, not to a gate or city wall. Prioritize the lived-in street front and long urban balconies. Not a symmetrical palace avenue, a top-down roof carpet, an open lecture court, a rustic village or another aerial panorama.

entries.title: 东市
entries.description: 多层商楼围合的街市转角与开阔铺街。
entries.scene: Scene: EAST MARKET DISTRICT at local quarter scale. Moderately elevated three-quarter view from an upper arcade corner, looking diagonally over an irregular merchant plaza and two intersecting paved shopping streets. Its characteristic tall enclosed merchant hall with stacked timber balconies, narrow lattice windows, restrained pitched roof and grey masonry piers stands in the RIGHT BACK/MIDDLE, as in reference 1. Street shops with varied widths and supported fabric awnings frame the LEFT and foreground; long urban galleries link their facades. A few empty modest display tables and baskets only, no busy clutter. Show the full accessible ground level and real paths between buildings. Composition is an asymmetric commercial street intersection with a tall backdrop, not a ceremonial courtyard, repeating equal-size buildings or a stand-alone temple pagoda. No city perimeter or fortification.

entries.title: 府前街
entries.description: 通往城守府官署的石阶、街面和侧巷。
entries.scene: Scene: STREET BEFORE THE CITY MAGISTRATE'S COMPOUND. Local civic street view with a slightly raised camera from the LEFT side of the broad fore-street. The formal urban grey-brick-and-dark-timber city office occupies the RIGHT upper-middle, reached by two coherent stone stair flights and real landings. A quieter lower administrative frontage and a roofed notice arcade lie to the LEFT, connected by a walkable stone fore-street. Include one clearly accessible modest side entrance leading toward the lecture/learning side court; it belongs to the civic compound rather than an independent district. Upper-storey closed lattice rooms, high stepped firebreak gables and heavy masonry bases; no sect altar, temple prayer hall or giant royal palace. The street crosses the lower frame diagonally and continues beyond both sides. This is not a centered duplicate of the whole city overview and not the lecture courtyard itself. Keep readable real ground and civic thresholds.

entries.title: 西城旧巷
entries.description: 高墙砖宅间的曲巷、院门与老树。
entries.scene: Scene: OLD WEST LANES. Close local lane view from modestly raised eye level, with a winding grey-stone lane coming from lower RIGHT and turning LEFT behind irregular grey-brick courtyard homes. Tall stepped firebreak gables, cool-grey masonry garden walls, small closed timber projecting window bays, inset solid wooden doors and occasional covered thresholds. Mature olive-green tree crowns rise from the courtyards and lean above the lane, but do not block the route. Suggest larger city merchant roofs beyond the nearer gables. The alley is cared-for and inhabited by its architecture, not a ruined slum, countryside hamlet or forest path. Asymmetric intimate street perspective, markedly different from the broad South Street and East Market views. No heroic central pavilion, endless roof grid, lecture furniture or palace forecourt.

entries.title: 客栈
entries.description: 带楼上回廊的客栈大堂。
entries.scene: Scene: INSIDE THE LARGE SOUTH STREET INN. A spacious TWO-STOREY INN LOBBY seen diagonally from a slightly elevated front corner, not an outdoor courtyard. Grey-brick lower walls, substantial dark timber structural posts, continuous upper-floor occupied guest-room gallery with CLOSED lattice doors and railings. A plausible broad staircase at the RIGHT BACK reaches that actual gallery with a clear supported landing. A service counter with closed ledgers and a few plain jars is at the LEFT middle. A restrained arrangement of empty square tables, stools and a tea service occupies the side bays, leaving the lower center open. The rear street doorway and side lattice windows admit cool neutral daylight, showing a glimpse of blue-grey city roofs outside. The lobby feels like a prosperous immortal-city inn with real guest rooms, not an imperial hall, private luxury bedroom, tavern fantasy dungeon or golden candlelit brown room. No red lantern flood, no writing or people.

entries.title: 坊市
entries.description: 有盖交易廊与可通行的柜铺。
entries.scene: Scene: WITHIN THE MARKET'S COVERED TRADING ARCADE, NOT the exterior East Market intersection. A broad ground-level arcade under a substantial urban merchant building, viewed diagonally along two connected bays. Cool-grey brick piers and dark timber beams support closed upper floors, with daylight entering from open arch-like rectangular side bays toward an adjacent paved market court. A row of restrained empty stone-and-timber trade counters lines the LEFT and recedes toward the middle; deeper shelf-fronted shop bays and a few closed crates stand at the RIGHT. Environmental goods are modest pottery, wrapped plain fabric, closed unlabeled wooden boxes and a few unlettered books, with no glowing artifacts or explicit weapons. Lower center is a clearly walkable stone-paved aisle, the stalls have reachable fronts and doors. Spacious commercial arcade, not a courtyard with a central ritual platform, an outdoor copy of East Market, or an inn dining lobby. Keep the same cool neutral daylight and modest colors even under the roof.

entries.title: 书坊
entries.description: 书架、阅书长案与二层藏书夹廊。
entries.scene: Scene: INTERIOR OF THE CITY BOOKSHOP. A tall but inviting urban brick-and-timber book room seen obliquely from just above normal eye level. High bookcases on the BACK and LEFT walls carry orderly closed books and manuscript bundles with blank grey-blue and ivory spines; a small upper mezzanine along the LEFT/BACK has a safe continuous railing and a short clearly supported stair reaching it. A long wooden reading/examination table lies to the RIGHT-middle beneath tall lattice windows, a few closed volumes and unlettered paper stacks on its top. The lower central stone floor remains uncluttered. Cool daylight from the RIGHT windows softly lights grey brick and low-chroma brown timber, with glimpses of Baishi tiled roofs outside. A distinctive diagonal library-room composition, not a symmetrical throne room, temple archive palace, shop counter arcade or another open court. No giant glowing scripture, particles, labeled shelves, legible book covers, signage or people.

entries.title: 告示所
entries.description: 半开放告示廊与城务办事柜台。
entries.scene: Scene: THE PUBLIC NOTICE OFFICE, a practical roofed semi-open civic notice gallery along the fore-street. View diagonally beneath a low urban timber arcade supported by grey brick piers. Two substantial public display boards fill the LEFT-middle bays, pinned only with a restrained number of COMPLETELY BLANK off-white paper sheets and blank unlettered wood surfaces. A small civic clerk counter with closed ledgers, simple drawers and a plain bench occupies the RIGHT-middle. The foreground is a generous clear stone-paved public approach, and the open side of the gallery reveals a sliver of the main street and the city office steps, physically connected. Blue-grey roof eaves and stepped gable ends echo Baishi. This should read as notices and ordinary public business, not a magical quest board, banquet hall, market goods shop or temple ritual court. No writing, glyph-like marks, faction seals, symbols, bulletin headings, people or human art.

Formal urban public office, visibly not Yuxu's mountain sect main hall, an imperial throne room, law-court punishment scene, guards' barracks or lecture platform. entries.scene: Scene: THE SHARED BEGINNER STUDY SIDE ROOM BEHIND THE LECTURE COURTYARD. A modest practical grey-brick-and-dark-timber side hall, viewed diagonally rather than symmetrically. The LEFT half has two low wooden reading desks and simple shelves of closed unlettered introductory books; the RIGHT half has three separate plain woven floor mats with enough clear space between them for quiet seated study/cultivation. A simple side bench and closed storage cabinet remain unobtrusive. Large lattice windows or an open side door in the BACK admit soft cool daylight and a glimpse of the same old tree / blue-grey lecture-court wall seen in reference 2, linking it to the existing court. No luxury private retreat, bedroom, bed, giant meditation dais, mystical altar, spirit spring, glowing runes or supernatural effects. This is ordinary shared beginner study space within the existing city compound, not a sect sanctuary. Preserve uncluttered foreground stone flooring, subdued neutral brightness and Baishi urban materials. No people or readable text.
